Questions

Before you visit

Can't find your answer? Call us on 96321 78786.

Can I test a laptop before I buy it?

Yes. Every machine on our shelves can be switched on and tried in the store. Check the keyboard, screen, ports and battery before you pay.

Do you sell MacBooks?

Yes. We stock MacBook Air and MacBook Pro models. Stock changes often, so call or WhatsApp us to check what's available today.

What does "Grade A+ refurbished" mean?

It's the top grade of refurbished stock we sell: fully tested machines in very good condition. We'll walk you through the exact condition of any unit you're interested in.

Can you upgrade RAM or storage?

Yes. We can add memory, fit a faster SSD, install the operating system and move your data from your old machine.

Do you take bulk orders for offices?

Yes. We supply matching laptops and desktops for offices, schools and startups. Tell us the quantity and specification and we'll prepare a quote.

Where exactly is the store?

680/58, 30th Cross, Swagath Road, 4th T Block East, Jayanagar, Bengaluru 560041. Use the Google Maps button below for directions.
